title: PunGraph: Retrieval-Enhanced Phonetic-Semantic Graph Reasoning for Pun Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2609.16557v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Puns are a challenging form of figurative language that exploit phonetic similarity and semantic ambiguity to convey multiple meanings. Although large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong language understanding capabilities, they still struggle with pun reasoning due to limited phonetic modeling and uncontrolled end-to-end generation. We propose \textbf{PunGraph}, a retrieval-enhanced knowledge graph framework for pun understanding. PunGraph constructs a phonetic-semantic lexical graph using the Unisyn phonetic dictionary, IPA and G2P representations, and WordNet definitions, and retrieves candidate words or senses to constrain LLM reasoning within a structured candidate space. translated_title: PunGraph：面向双关语理解的检索增强音义图推理
translated_abstract: 双关语是一种具有挑战性的比喻语言形式，它利用语音相似性和语义歧义来传达多重含义。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）展现出了强大的语言理解能力，但由于语音建模能力有限以及端到端生成不可控，它们在双关语推理方面仍存在困难。我们提出了PunGraph，一个用于双关语理解的检索增强知识图谱框架。PunGraph利用Unisyn语音词典、IPA和G2P表示以及WordNet定义构建了一个音义词汇图，并通过检索候选词或词义，将LLM的推理约束在结构化的候选空间内。我们还进一步推出了WebPun，一个新的大规模数据集，包含5,730条标注好的异形双关语和同形双关语。在SemEval-2017和WebPun上的实验表明，PunGraph持续提升了小型LLM的性能，并取得了具有竞争力的结果。
tldr: PunGraph通过构建音义词汇图并检索候选词义来约束大语言模型推理，显著提升了双关语理解能力，同时发布了包含5,730条标注双关语的新数据集WebPun。
en_tdlr: PunGraph improves LLM-based pun understanding by constructing a phonetic-semantic lexical graph for retrieval-constrained reasoning, and introduces WebPun, a new large-scale dataset of 5,730 annotated puns.
